elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, at Client’s request, provide transition assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided at “TrueLink’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination, TrueLink must return all Client Content and other Client data within 30 days.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: All Client Content and other Client data must be returned “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return, TrueLink must delete the data from its systems and certify deletion in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must make transition assistance available at Client’s request for up to six months, which includes a requested 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination, TrueLink must return all Client Content and other Client data in machine-readable form within 30 days, satisfying the export requirement.
